scope: offline diagnosis only; no API/live/Docker/backend edits

old_case.reason: Case was prepared with the deployed parser pin aa3e/b0ba while the staged first pending PDF is bbc8/c60; it also contains only one of the two pending documents.

root_cause.failure_path: fields.review_fields catches source parser ValueError and marks titulo/orgao/edital_numero/inscricao_inicio/inscricao_fim/prova_data/cargos/remuneracao FAILED; it does not silently fall through to generic values.

case_semantics.prepare_preserved: Reuses the existing case only when identity, one-document shape, document identity, SHA and registered blob all match; otherwise returns 409. It cannot append the second pending PDF or reparse the old case.
case_semantics.prepare: Checks current case against the complete pending manifest multiset and every blob/hash. The old one-document case fails that check for two pending PDFs, then the normal prepare path extracts all wanted documents and inserts a new random drc-* case; it does not delete/invalidate the old row.
case_semantics.current: Returns the newest unapproved case matching the current revision and extraction method. Operational review must inspect that the replacement case has exactly both expected SHA values before any decision.
case_semantics.approve: Requires one decision per distinct document SHA; therefore the replacement case must contain both PDFs. Never approve the old one-document failed case.

safe_reprocessing_procedure: Deploy/integrate the corrected source-specific parser pin bbc8/c60 before any prepare retry; the current backend pin remains stale and will reproduce the blocker.
Do not call prepare-preserved for the old case; it is single-document recovery and cannot add the sibling PDF.

Run normal prepare once for the exact run after parser integration. Verify new case identity/run/revision and exactly two documents: c60fcc... (48 pages) and 49b213... (49 pages), with registered blobs and parser-supported fields.
Keep old case drc-preserved-1d4a... as immutable audit history; do not approve it, delete it, or treat its failed fields as current.
Only after independent review of both documents may an operator make two SHA-bound decisions; no proposal retry is part of this procedure.
